name: Auto Language Block
description: Blocks people who write in the language you pick, by looking for words of that language in their messages. Blocking changes your account and the plugin cannot undo it: unblock a person in Discord. It never blocks your friends or yourself.

credits.name: Vendicated and contributors (Vencord), plugin AutoLanguageBlock by Neversleeper (under her earlier name soriita), as found in TestCord
